body.purpose: Prose and UI text at 12–18px. Max 65–75ch per line.

display.purpose: Hero claims and big statements only. Never UI chrome.

headline.purpose: Page titles and section heads in DM Sans bold.

label.purpose: The citation voice: provenance, status, metadata.

dos: Do keep Seminar Indigo rare (≤10% of any screen) — The One Voice Rule.
Do use Fraunces for statements and DM Sans for everything functional — The Statements-Only Rule.
Do separate resting surfaces with hairlines and tonal steps, reserving shadow for overlays, press states, and paper.
Do write specific, verifiable copy with exact numbers and named pages.
Do hold body text to ≥4.5:1 (large ≥3:1) and functional text to ≥11px — The Floor Rule.
Do give every icon-only control an accessible name and a visible focus ring.
donts: Don't ship generic AI SaaS: no gradient heroes, no gradient text (`background-clip: text` is forbidden), no big-number metric templates, no glassmorphism, no pulsing liveness baits.
Don't build identical card grids — same-sized icon + heading + text cards repeated endlessly. Vary topology or don't build the grid.
Don't put a tiny uppercase tracked eyebrow above sections, or numbered `01 / 02 / 03` markers anywhere except a genuine ordered sequence.
Don't use `border-left` / `border-right` over 1px as a colored accent on cards, callouts, or alerts.
Don't animate layout properties, bounce, or elastic easing; motion conveys state at 150–200ms with exponential ease-out, and every animation respects `prefers-reduced-motion`.
Don't fake UI: no dead buttons, no stub actions, no invented data, no limits revealed after commitment.
keyCharacteristics: Editorial restraint: single accent, neutral canvas, flat borders
Provenance as a material: serif claims, sans body, mono citations
Specific, verifiable copy over marketing filler
narrative.overview: Studium looks like a quiet library, not a software demo: ink on reading white, one indigo accent kept rare, hairline rules setting the cadence between sections. Density is comfortable, never packed; flat bordered surfaces carry the interface while depth appears only where the system rises to meet the user — a modal veil, a toast, a sheet of paper. Typography does the persuading: a Fraunces serif makes the claims, DM Sans does the work, and JetBrains Mono stamps provenance (page numbers, statuses, metadata) in small tracked capitals.

rules.body: Seminar Indigo appears on ≤10% of any screen. Its rarity is the point; if everything is accented, nothing is.
rules.name: The One Voice Rule

rules.body: In dark mode, fills use Seminar Indigo (#4f46e5) while small text uses Indigo Pale (#818cf8, 6.22:1 on night surfaces). One indigo cannot serve text and fill at once — the roles split by theme.
rules.name: The Split Ramp Rule

rules.body: Status colors always ship as light/dark pairs: Emerald Seal (#047857) with light emerald in dark mode, Signal Red (#dc2626) with light red in dark mode. Never a single status hue across themes.
rules.name: The Status Pairing Rule

rules.body: Fraunces appears on claims and headlines that persuade. UI labels, buttons, data, and navigation stay in DM Sans. Serif in chrome is forbidden.
rules.name: The Statements-Only Rule

rules.body: Functional text never drops below 11px; body copy never below 12px. Small is a label, never an excuse.
rules.name: The Floor Rule

rules.body: Cards sit flat with border-only hover (border-color shifts, nothing lifts). A shadow on a resting card is a defect.
rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
